capabilities: Chat with DeepSeek inline inside any note, with history stored in %% comment markers
Run 21 AI tools that search the vault, create and edit notes, browse the web, and query Wikipedia and arXiv
Stream AI responses into the note and capture DeepSeek reasoning in collapsible comment blocks
Fill text between a +++ prefix and suffix marker with FIM completion from a separate model
Configure vault-wide AI instructions via an auto-created NOTEBRAIN.md file and per-tool permission settings
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian. DeepSeek API use is pay-per-use. UI language defaults to Chinese. Optional headless browser endpoint can be set for JS-rendered page fetching.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to converse with an AI model inside a note, let one that reads the note's context or acts on the vault with tools.
